entry.title: Ivanti security advisory (AV26-1035) - Update 2
entry.content:
Serial number: AV26-1035
Date: October 13, 2026
Updated: October 30, 2026

As of October 13, 2026, Ivanti is affected by vulnerabilities in the following products:

  • Ivanti Connect Secure
    • Versions prior to 25.1.1.3
    • Versions prior to 25.1.3.1
    • Versions prior to 22.8R2.6
  • Ivanti Neurons Patch for Intune
    • Versions prior to September 16, 2026
  • Ivanti Xtraction
    • Versions prior to 2026.4

On October 13, 2026, Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) added CVE-2026-104935 to their Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) Database.

Update 1

Open-source reporting indicates that CVE-2026-111357 is being exploited in the wild.

Update 2

On October 30, 2026, Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) added CVE-2026-111357 and CVE-2026-118527 to their Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) Catalog.

The Cyber Centre encourages users and administrators to review the provided web links and apply any necessary updates as they become available.

  • Security Advisory Ivanti Connect Secure (CVE-2026-104935)
  • Security Advisory Ivanti Xtraction (Multiple CVEs)
  • Security Advisory Ivanti Neurons Patch for Intune October 2026 (CVE-2026-109412)
  • Ivanti Security Advisories
  • CISA KEV: CVE-2026-104935
  • CISA KEV: CVE-2026-111357
  • CISA KEV: CVE-2026-118527
